facts.fact: Data.FI Project says the layer connects three health platforms to DHIS2, four systems in all, out of more than 32 digital health platforms Niger had in 2023.

facts.fact: At the 8 July 2026 workshop validating the e-Santé roadmap 2025-2029, the national interoperability layer was demonstrated and its presenter said it is already operational with several systems, with Estelab disease-surveillance data now transferred automatically into DHIS2 without manual weekly entry at health centres, districts and hospitals.

systems.owner: Direction de la e-Santé, Ministère de la Santé et de l'Hygiène publique

note: Only two systems (Estelab, DHIS2) are named as exchanging; 'plusieurs systèmes' is not a count of three, so no breadth fact.

facts.fact: Bluesquare says that from 30 June to 6 July 2025 a workshop with the Ministry of Health's e-Santé directorate set up the OpenHEXA interoperability platform on ministry servers, with a roadmap for production use and a second workshop planned for October-November 2025 for two use cases (SNIS to OpenHEXA to Superset, and ERA5 to OpenHEXA to DEDOP/NMDR).

systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé et de l'Hygiène Publique (Direction de la e-Santé)

facts.fact: OpenFn says two automated workflows, STELab laboratory results to DHIS2 and CommCare/eCHIS community health data to DHIS2, are complete and operational on a Ministry of Public Health server in Niamey.
OpenFn says STELab, CommCare/eCHIS and DHIS2, three health systems, now exchange data through the Ministry's first national interoperability layer, with OpenClinic planned for a later phase.
